name: routing-latency
notes: Median time for one routing decision on the deployed image, five varied asks, routing-decision cache cleared each time so every pass is a real model call. MCP tool-listing cache off: median 7.53s, total 32.1s. On (300s TTL): median 3.23s, total 20.1s. The difference is the internet stdio server being spawned two or three times per decision to re-read a catalogue that had not changed: 1.0-1.1s per resolve_tool, against a 1.8s model call.
